description: This source file defines the ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel class, which models the interest schedule for progressive loans. It includes methods for managing repayment periods, interest rates, and interest calculations. The class supports deep copying, interest rate adjustments, and schedule modifications based on various loan terminologies and schedules.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel
classes.description: A model representing the schedule of interest calculations for a progressive loan, including repayment periods, interest rates, and various schedule manipulations.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current interest schedule model with a specified MathContext.

methods.name: copyWithoutPaidAmounts
methods.description: Returns a copy of the schedule model with paid amounts excluded.

methods.name: getInterestRate
methods.description: Retrieves the applicable interest rate for a given effective date.

methods.name: addInterestRate
methods.description: Adds a new interest rate effective from a specified date.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriodByDueDate
methods.description: Finds a repayment period by its due date.

methods.name: getRelatedRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Retrieves the repayment periods from a specified date onward.

methods.name: getLoanTermInDays
methods.description: Calculates the total duration of the loan in days.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Gets the starting date of the repayment schedule.

methods.name: getMaturityDate
methods.description: Gets the last due date of the repayment schedule.

methods.name: changeOutstandingBalanceAndUpdateInterestPeriods
methods.description: Updates interest periods and outstanding balances based on a balance change date.

methods.name: updateInterestPeriodsForInterestPause
methods.description: Adjusts interest periods to account for periods of interest pause.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Finds a repayment period by a specific transaction date.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the schedule contains any disbursed amounts.

methods.name: getLastRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Returns the last repayment period.

methods.name: isLastRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a given repayment period is the last one.

methods.name: copyPeriodsFrom
methods.description: Copies attributes from a list of periods starting from a specific due date.

methods.name: disableEMIRecalculation
methods.description: Disables EMI recalculation modifier.

methods.name: isEMIRecalculationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if EMI recalculation is enabled.

methods.name: isCopy
methods.description: Returns whether the model is marked as a copy.

methods.name: resolveRepaymentPEriodLengthGeneratorFunction
methods.description: Provides a function to generate successive repayment period dates based on the repayment frequency type.
